`video.webm` is a generated 15-second, 320×180 VP8/Opus test clip: moving colored shapes, a timestamp, and a quiet 440 Hz tone. It contains no downloaded video or personal data. It was recorded from a canvas and oscillator using Chromium's MediaRecorder and remuxed to add a seekable timeline. Its moving frames and audio track let tests verify real rendering, seeking, and audio isolation.
